event_pipeline.summary: Three fire-and-forget server emitters POST ~55 event names + dynamic trial_* families to env-configured CLOSE_WEBHOOK_URL(_<LABEL>). No retry/queue/dead-letter anywhere - all downstream loss is consistent with that. External pipeline writes imai_events, then fans out.

emitters.white_label: per-label URL, identity STRIPPED from payload

event_pipeline.frontend_bridge: POST /data/pipedrive/trial-event: client picks whitelisted trial_* names; errors swallowed both sides; limit-family deduped once per user+event per day
event_pipeline.flow: emitters -> CLOSE_WEBHOOK_URL (receiver UNKNOWN, Q1) -> imai_events (logs DB) -> {Mixpanel sync (lossy/lagging, strips ALL payload props - Q27), Klaviyo (~10% loss), Close CRM (stages mirror BACK as events)}

destinations_mixpanel_namespaces.notes: payload properties STRIPPED (Q27); renames: new_subscription_trial->'Free Trial Signup', cancel_subscription->'Cancelled Subscription'
$import:true batch job (Platform Usage ~1.6M/30d, Login, Influencer Search...); source job unidentified (Q24); DUPLICATES several snake_case events
Payment Attempt / Added Payment Method with Stripe-native props incl. Amount Charged (whole USD) - includes renewals+dunning, NOT funnel steps; completeness unverified (Q28)
Close pipeline stages; no status_id (Sales vs CS ambiguous, Q6); NOT product events

make.com: CANCELLATION_WEBHOOK_URL (rich cancel payload) + hardcoded email-test hook

invariants_for_next_agent: NEVER push to InfluencerMarketing-Ai/Discovery-imai from data-work sessions (standing user rule). All docs/analysis live in caras-new-voices/imai-data-work.

NEVER build dollar analysis on webhook events (36% of recurring dollars, June 2026). Dollars = prod user_payments + Close; Stripe-integration Mixpanel dollars usable for Stripe engine only, pending Q28.
Never mix Mixpanel namespaces in one KPI ('Login' vs user_logged_in, 'Signup' vs signup, 'Influencer Search' vs influencer_discovery_search 41% apart - Q25).
Exclude user_created_by_admin accounts from funnels; roll team members up via main_user_id; calendar-day windows.
Event birth dates: cancel_trial 2026-04-22; trial_* friction family 2026-06-30; created_list 2026-07. Trends crossing those dates are measurement changes.
payment_failed is dunning noise - count DISTINCT users.
created_campaign AND campaign_created both fire on create (Q9) - dedupe.
amount fields are WHOLE USD; IL-billed x1.17 VAT on some paths; Close deal values are cents.
Three things are called 'pixel': customer conversion SDK (sdk/pixel.js -> /tracking/*), legacy AWS visit pixel (t.imai.co), and the logs DB nickname. Do not conflate.
Event delivery is best-effort by design (no retry/queue) - expect gaps downstream.
The proxy and backend/main use DIFFERENT prod conventions ('production' vs 'prod') - check before adding env gates.
trial_analytics_report.cancel_date counts any %cancel% event incl. started_cancellation_process - do not trust it for churn.
